title: Fermionic Anomalies of Finite Symmetries on Lattices
summary: We develop a lattice characterization of fermionic 't Hooft anomalies of finite internal symmetries in one and two spatial dimensions, formulated in terms of obstructions to symmetric short-range-entangled (SRE) states. We consider lattice systems formed by tensor product of onsite fermionic and bosonic local degrees of freedom, and finite internal symmetry given by a central extension $\mathbb Z_2^F\to G_f\to G_b$.
